blinding: all comment lines stripped (the generator writes '# Expected:' and '# Rationale:' headers)
case identifier withheld (its SAFE/VULN suffix names the class)
presentation order keyed on sha256(case_id): reproducible, uncorrelated with the label
views screened for residual label vocabulary before labelling
method.rater2_is: an automated (LLM) rater, NOT an independent human investigator
method.rater2_note: model identity and version, access route, decoding parameters and the exact instruction were not recorded when the pass was run and are not reconstructed; the labelling cannot be repeated, though the agreement figure can be recomputed from the recorded labels

limitations.shared_provenance: rater 2's reading of CIS control text derives from the same public documentation the specifications were written from, so the raters are not fully independent and agreement is biased upward
limitations.contamination_note: these five were inspected during earlier debugging in the same session, so their agreement is not blind; all five agreed
limitations.residual_blinding_leak: cis_examples/cis_3_1_cloudtrail declares resource "aws_cloudtrail" "insecure_trail"; CIS-illustrating content of unrecorded provenance, flagged by the screen and left unmodified rather than renamed
limitations.kappa_sensitivity: with 26/22 class balance at n=48, one disagreement moves kappa by roughly 0.04; the interval around 0.958 is wide

reconciliation.resolved_by: correcting the control text, not the label
reconciliation.title_before: Object storage bucket lacks server-side encryption
reconciliation.title_after: Object storage bucket not encrypted with a customer-managed key
reconciliation.why: the label encoded a customer-managed-key requirement the stated text did not; requiring a CMK is defensible and is what the corpus, the policy set and the CMK rules of all three source-level scanners test. Relabelling instead would have left the vulnerable/compliant pair testing nothing.
reconciliation.post_reconciliation_note: under the corrected title an AES256 bucket does violate the control, so rater 2 would agree; this is stated for clarity and does NOT revise the 47/48 figure above, which is pre-reconciliation
